historical_floor16_rationale: Under independent with-replacement draws, expected >=16 presentations/group bounded the chance that any group received zero draws.
new_full_coverage_fact: Every reader-fit stable cell key is deterministically presented at least once, so every donor×operator group has zero probability of receiving zero presentations before any repeat top-up.
independence_warning: Repeating a one-cell group 16 times still provides one unique biological cell; presentation count must not be interpreted as independent biological support.

decision_boundary.recommended_next_rule: Separate unique group support from optimization repeat allocation. If a minimum repeat floor is retained, justify it prospectively as an optimization-variance control, not as independent biological coverage.
